M1.rule: primary beats the best source-free or sparse estimator in >= 12 of the 16 MeshRIR cells and loses in none

M2.rule: primary non-inferior to the group-sparse and the cap-5 region kernel in every MeshRIR cell, and pooled superior to each

M3.rule: primary never loses to the sinc kernel on MeshRIR

M4.rule: secondary: remainder-family variant beats the best source-free or sparse estimator in every 125-250 Hz MeshRIR cell

stop_rule.rule: ask the user if the primary loses to the best comparator in more than 4 of 16 cells or in the pooled comparison

held_out_same_recordings.note: descriptive only: the S4/S7/S8 recordings were seen in TB-M1 and in development
